title: When a message containing an OpenPGP key attachment was displayed, Thunderbird automatically loaded the attachment's…
description: A vulnerability in Thunderbird allowed automatic loading of attacker-controlled URLs via OpenPGP key attachments without user interaction, bypassing remote content blocking. On Windows, this could leak NTLM credentials to an attacker-controlled network share. The issue was fixed in Thunderbird 159 and 153.6.
